description: Half-hexagon mosaic otti tile from Pak Clay. Otti tiles are laid in colourful patterns, and the half-hexagon shape fits together into flowing, honeycomb-style layouts for paths, porches and garden areas. Shades vary between pieces, so view a sample and plan the layout before fixing. Prepare a firm, sloped base for drainage, ask your fixer about the right bedding, and order the full quantity from one batch with a margin for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
